entries.title: Neet's story chapters are here
notes: Neet’s tier-1 through tier-5 story chapters are now playable.
Inside a chapter, choose any unlocked Life, Mana or Stamina route to shape the story.
Read the trip report afterward, and replay it anytime in the Story journal.
Selling a matching potion shortens an active story trip’s wait.
A one-time gift of 10 rubies is waiting below.

entries.title: New journeys, potion commissions, and a livelier shop
notes: Potion commissions are here! Choose one of three orders and hand over three matching potions. There is no fee or deadline, and every delivery is saved. Completing orders grants boosts and likeability; every third completed commission also includes a fairy while unmaxed fairies remain.

Commission names follow potion tiers, and each Life, Mana and Stamina offer chooses a random unlocked recipe. Choices remain saved until you complete a commission. The permanent Orders icon below the visitor shows progress and delivers a qualifying potion with one click. Matching short visitor quests keep priority on the Sell button.

Visitor expeditions now have their own menu. Choose a portrait, read the visitor’s introduction and Pio- or Tia-specific greeting, then choose a job from the three-column material-tier grid. Kyle sits beside Tirami in the visitor picker.

There are 250 original character-inspired expedition jobs: 25 for every visitor. Neet gathers supplies for her shrine, Daisy works around bakery deliveries, Demian checks records, Kyle searches his stockpile, and the others have their own approaches.

A job tier opens when any one material family reaches that tier; only families at that tier can offer their material as that job's story route. The material shapes the story and is not awarded when the trip returns. Only a visitor currently offering or waiting for a potion order can be dispatched. Dispatch replaces that order and costs gold; prices increase with the assignment and material tier. Other visitors, brewing and commissions continue during a trip.

Expeditions continue while the game is closed. Every new trip combines guaranteed stamps, likeability and character-specific supplies with random fairy and currency bonuses. Higher tiers increase supplies and stamp payouts. Fairy pools follow both visitor specialties and material progression.

Fairies are selected from the available pool at dispatch. Misses are saved for each fairy, with a guaranteed find after two misses when that fairy is selected again. Supply bonuses and fairy results are combined into one trip; hover a job to inspect its full reward information.

The Stamp Exchange lets you choose boost charges, Pushcat tickets or fairy copies. All 42 fairy entries are included behind material-tier gates; maxed fairies cannot be exchanged. Stamps and promised trip rewards are saved, and older trips retain their original rewards.

Traveler order windows are larger and now explain why the character wants the requested material-tier potion. Flavor is split into readable paragraphs. Potion names are colored in both the dialogue and the order details. An Expeditions button beside the order actions opens that visitor’s page directly.

Enhancement now takes three seconds, with a pink-purple progress bar on the cauldron above the fire. Selling, deliveries, repeated enhancement and ingredient additions are blocked during the wait. Beany-Kong and the other enhancement-time fairy bonuses shorten the wait.

Failed enhancements now produce a brighter burst, larger dissipating smoke clouds, a brief cauldron shake and a fuller puff sound. Reduced motion uses a simpler fade; effects volume controls the sound.

Enhancement Success Rate now has 19 purchases following the supplied bonus progression, reaching +10.345 percentage points. Prices fit our gold economy, and existing purchased ranks are preserved. Stamina’s revised base chance reaches 95% with maximum ordinary upgrades, before fairy or consumable bonuses; the overall ceiling remains 99%.

Pushcats now choose random empty conveyor spots while keeping existing cats in place. The summon button has less text. Visitors announce their arrival with a real shop-door bell recording, trimmed to 1.1 seconds. Music starts automatically and loops, with a first-interaction fallback when the browser blocks autoplay.
All 11 rotating event banners now have English story text above redemption. Original banner objectives remain historical context; current event rewards still use Miracle Solution.

The Fairy Collection has wider, more spacious cards. The Potion Book keeps its top controls fixed while its collection and detail panes scroll independently, with the attribution merged into its top notes. Menu and Settings headers now stay visible when scrolling.

Life, Mana and Stamina labels use their family colors across the interface. Rewards use amounts and asset icons, including the new expedition stamp, with tooltips for clarity. Commission descriptions highlight the required level and color the potion name.
Mail now has Claim all, so you can collect every pending gift at once. Thank you for helping shape the shop—this update includes a one-time gift of 20 rubies!

entries.title: A helping paw for your potion shop
notes: Pushcat is here! Use the paw button above your fairy to summon a helper for one ticket. You might get the faster Blackcat!
Keep up to eight cats on the conveyor at once. Each keeps its own spot, working timer and collection cooldown. Cats pop up only when a drop passes over their head.
Helpers collect ingredients, Pushcat tickets and Miracle Solution. Ingredients fall into your cauldron; tickets and Solution go to their balances.
Each summon starts with 60 working seconds before bonuses. Cats pause while the cauldron is empty or the game is hidden or closed, and their timers survive reloads.
Pushcat Speed has 15 levels. Upgrades speed up active cats immediately, and the summon controls show catch intervals, working time and Blackcat odds.
Pushcat Fairy, Blackcat Fairy, Halloprin and Behe join the collection. Helper-related fairy bonuses and ticket bonuses now work; entries show their exact effects.
During HALAK’s Birthday, new summons get double working time. During Summer Part 2, Blackcat odds are multiplied by five. Summon statistics and milestone gifts are tracked too.
Enjoy the ingredient-drop and cat-jump animations, or skip them with Reduced motion in Settings. Thank you for playing—claim 10 rubies below!

entries.title: Get to know your fairy companions
notes: Wondering what your fairy actually does? The Fairy Collection now shows exact bonuses at its current level.
Uncollected fairies show a level-1 preview. Expand At level 10 to see how their abilities grow.

32 of our 38 fairies currently have working abilities. Beany-Kong, Magi-Run and King-Poong have no implemented effect; Forest, Fire and Water Fairy summon bonuses are inactive. Their entries now say so clearly.
Visitor-time bonuses show the resulting seconds, and enhancement bonuses use the current game balance.
Back to menu buttons now share the same background, border and spacing across menu pages and dialogs.
Thanks for helping improve the shop! Claim 10 rubies below and keep brewing.

entries.title: A smoother shop and safer saves
notes: Conveyor now travels left to right, with denser materials as Emission improves.
New settings for audio, conveyor speed, shortcuts, motion, dialogue and text size.
Five-second autosaves, recovery backups and shareable save files.
Refreshed event sidebar, visitor dialogue, potion panels and notices.
Regular costumes now cost 200 tickets; duplicate skins grant 200 tickets.
Reduced unnecessary interface updates for smoother play.
